Kyle: If the doctor's plan succeeds, Earth's defenses will be stronger than ever.

Kyle: Celcia, remember what happened back then.
Kyle: Adler's scheming buried the project in darkness.
Kyle: Everything we'd worked for was thrown out over petty jealousy.
Kyle: And then, amid the fighting, we each lost something precious.
Kyle: I lost my pride... and you lost a friend. Remember the frustration and grief you felt then.
Celcia: B-But...
Kyle: Then lend me your strength. We need you... No, I need you.
